qa_pair.question: A teacher wants to create a complete Physics 11 course on AeroEdu about harmonic oscillation. Using aeroedu_course_create followed by aeroedu_chapter_add, what field name should be used for the subject parameter when creating a Physics course?
When calling aeroedu_course_list with default parameters, what is the default value for the "limit" parameter according to the tool's input schema?
A teacher wants to add a lesson that contains interactive simulation exercises for students. Which "type" value should they use in aeroedu_lesson_add for a hands-on simulation lesson?

When using aeroedu_exam_create to create a Vietnamese high school style exam with 4-statement true/false questions (chuẩn THPT), what is the exact "type" string to use for each such question in the questions array?
The aeroedu_kg_search tool supports filtering by subject. What value should be passed to search across ALL subjects without filtering to a specific one?

A teacher has a PDF textbook chapter on "Newton's Laws of Motion" for Grade 10 Physics. They want to use aeroedu_kg_extract to preview what Knowledge Graph nodes would be extracted WITHOUT automatically adding them to the KG. What value should the "auto_add" parameter be?
When a student completes a lesson and the AI tutor records their learning visit using aeroedu_kg_record_visit, what is the default value for the "source" parameter?

The aeroedu_kg_path_find tool uses a graph traversal algorithm to find the optimal learning path between two knowledge nodes. According to the tool description, what algorithm does it use to find the shortest path through prerequisites?
The aeroedu_course_list tool supports pagination. After a page of results, which field in the response indicates the offset value to use for the next page of results?

According to the aeroedu_kg_node_detail tool's input schema, what is the default value for the "include_resources" parameter that controls whether learning materials (videos, quizzes, reading) are returned alongside the node details?
